creating: Your profile is being created. Sign out and in again if this stays.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.emptyBody: Titles you add, lists you create and sessions you watch will show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.verifyNote: Verify it to share lists and plans with friends.
settings.sent: Sent. Check your inbox and the spam folder.
settings.themeNote: Saved to your account, so your other devices follow. System matches this device.
settings.languageNote: Applies at once and is saved to your account.

push.label: Push notifications on this device
push.hint: Get a notice when a friend shares a list or plan with you or changes your access. Works even when Avleron is closed.
push.failed: Couldn’t change this. Check your connection and try again.

blocked.unsupported: This browser doesn’t support push notifications.
blocked.needs-install: On iPhone and iPad, add Avleron to the Home Screen first, then open it from there and turn this on.
blocked.unconfigured: Push notifications aren’t set up for this version of the app.
blocked.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser’s site settings, then come back.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: One link with every session of all your plans. Add it to Google Calendar or any calendar app and your viewing evenings show up next to everything else.
calendar.manual: Copy the link by hand: it is selected.
calendar.step1: In Google Calendar, open Other calendars → From URL.
calendar.step2: Paste the link and add the calendar.
calendar.step3: Open it from the list on the left whenever you want to hide it.
calendar.refresh: Google refreshes subscribed calendars only every few hours, so a new or moved session can take a while to show up.
calendar.private: Anyone with this link can see your sessions. If it gets out, make a new one.
calendar.zone: Times follow the time zone of the device that made the link: {{zone}}.
calendar.renewWarning: The current link stops working at once. Calendars that use it must be given the new one.
calendar.removeWarning: The link stops working and calendars using it go empty. You can create a new one later.
calendar.failed: Couldn’t change this. Check your connection and try again.

name.label: Display name
name.hint: Friends see this on shared lists and plans. {{length}}/{{max}}

avatar.title: Your avatar
avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.note: A photo or an emoji. You see it in the header and on your profile.

photo.intro: Choose a photo, then drag and zoom it into the circle. It is made small and saved to your profile.
photo.cropLabel: Photo position. Drag it, or use the arrow keys to move and plus and minus to zoom.
photo.cropHint: Drag the photo to move it.
photo.notImage: This file is not an image this browser can open. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP.
photo.tooBig: This photo is too big. Choose one under 15 MB.
photo.tooLarge: The photo is too detailed to save. Zoom in on a simpler part or choose another one.
